# mv: convert function to method with multiple params (funcToMethod coverage)
mv F T.F
-- x.go --
package m

type T struct{}

func F(t *T, x, y int) int {
	return x + y
}

func G(t *T) int {
	return F(t, 1, 2)
}
-- stdout --
diff old/x.go new/x.go
--- old/x.go
+++ new/x.go
@@ -2,10 +2,10 @@

 type T struct{}

-func F(t *T, x, y int) int {
+func (t *T) F(x, y int) int {
 	return x + y
 }

 func G(t *T) int {
-	return F(t, 1, 2)
+	return t.F(1, 2)
 }
